summary: PR 2383 is valid test-only hardening at exact commit e08baaaa5812a00905d6734eebc50133cdc6ff80. It makes no production change. The recorded base already rejects a PD request before decode dispatch when the prefill breaker is open, and the candidate's three tests pass. Independent cases also pass for the exact chat-completions endpoint and for a failed half-open probe reopening the breaker. This does not reproduce or repair the historical v0.2.4 abort-driven failure, so it must not be characterized as a full original-issue fix.

tests.command: cargo test --test routing_tests pd_circuit_breaker -- --nocapture (exact candidate e08baaaa5812a00905d6734eebc50133cdc6ff80; Rust 1.90; private CARGO_TARGET_DIR)
tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression suite: open healthy prefill returns 503, two successful half-open probes close the breaker, and open decode returns 503. 3 passed; raw output in exact-candidate-tests.txt.

tests.command: cargo test --test routing_tests pd_circuit_breaker -- --nocapture with temporary review-only chat-endpoint and failed-half-open cases
tests.what_was_measured: Independent adversarial coverage: /v1/chat/completions fails fast with 503 when prefill is open; a failing half-open prefill probe records a server error, returns the breaker to Open, and the next request returns 503. 5 total tests passed; raw output in adversarial-tests.txt.
Candidate formatting. Stable rustfmt warned that repository nightly-only import grouping options were ignored.
No production or native source differences; candidate is tests/reports only.

gpu_execution.evidence: rocminfo exposes the assigned gfx950 / AMD Instinct MI350X, but this candidate is a Rust HTTP router integration test with mock workers and has no GPU/model execution path. No GPU correctness claim is made.

remaining_counterexamples: The exact sgl-router v0.2.4 binary and its historical abort-driven transition into the fake-dead state were not available or reproduced; current prepared base behavior is already different.
No real prefill/decode engines, model weights, Mooncake/KV transport, or multi-node 1P1D deployment verified that decode receives no bootstrap allocation under the historical failure.
The candidate forces the breaker open rather than generating the original client-timeout/abort burst, so it does not validate the complete causal chain reported in the issue.
Half-open recovery was validated sequentially with HTTP mocks, not under concurrent probes or a distributed workload.
remaining_limitations: This is test-only hardening of current-tree behavior, not a production fix for the original release.
The candidate uses /generate; the independent review covered /v1/chat/completions temporarily and retained its output, but that exact-endpoint test is not part of the candidate patch.
The assigned gfx950 was present but irrelevant and unused; there was no GPU numerical work to validate.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was required. The gateway Rust test binary was freshly compiled from /job/repo/sgl-model-gateway using Rust 1.90 and a private target directory.
